description: React component for managing ticket types within an event, including adding, updating, and removing ticket types, with validation against event capacity.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Updates the form state for a specific ticket type input field.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles form submission to add a new ticket type, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing ticket type with new data, validating against event capacity.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes a ticket type after user confirmation.
